rules.description: Presence check for a required field.
Canonical JSON/value type check.
Reject explicit null when nullable is false.
Minimum string length.
Maximum string length.
Configured regular-expression match.
Syntactic email address format validation without claiming mailbox existence.
Absolute or contract-allowed URL format validation.
Phone normalization/format validation according to declared phone policy.
Lowercase URL-safe slug validation.
Canonical CSS color token format permitted by the field contract.
Minimum numeric value.
Maximum numeric value.
No fractional component.
Maximum decimal places.
Configured numeric increment.
Configured percentage boundary validation.
ISO calendar date validation.
ISO local time validation.
ISO 8601 timestamp validation with required timezone policy.
Value must be one of configured options.
Minimum array length.
Maximum array length.
Canonical items must be unique.
Referenced value must target the declared contract/entity type.
Referenced record must exist and be visible to the validating server context.
Asset MIME type must match the allowlist.
File extension must match the allowlist when configured.
Asset size must not exceed configured limit.
Image dimensions must meet configured bounds.
Value must be valid structured JSON according to the field policy.
Code value remains inert text and cannot imply execution permission.
Latitude must be -90..90 and longitude -180..180.
Address object must use the primitive address value shape.
Location object must use the primitive location value shape.
Reject direct write attempts when field is read-only in the active context.
Hidden field writes follow server-side field authorization, never UI visibility alone.
